reviews.t: it really just looks like packed dry brown sugar

The smell is pure sugar, which kind of surprised me, since it has so many different oils in it. But, like I said, it is fairly dry in the jar. I loved this product so much, it made my skin feel soft instantly. My skin is still soft even tho I haven't used it for a while since I ran out of it. The only reason I'm giving this product 4 stars is because the container is really small!!!! :( However, I'll be ordering more soon. Ps: One thing you should know tho is that if water falls into the container, it will make the scrub become stones. Besides that, I'm really satisfied with it.

reviews.t: At first this was pretty good despite having to stir it like crazy to ...
reviews.x: At first this was pretty good despite having to stir it like crazy to get the oil to mix with the sugar scrub. Then, it was horrible. The contents hardened to the point of solid chunks which I am now unable to use the more than half of the container left. I would NOT recommend this product. It is a waste of money since you can't use the whole jar before it hardens into large chunks.

reviews.t: Great Scrub, Scent is Too Strong
reviews.x: Gently rub a small amount on wet skin after showering, then rinse. I have sensitive skin and the oils are non-irritating and leave you feeling great after a shower. The smell is too strong (like cheap vanilla) so I wish it was unscented. CAUTION: The shower floor will be slippery after rinsing off.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the scrub arrives or becomes dried out and hardened into an unusable solid block.
Reviewers praise the pleasant brown sugar smell and how soft and moisturized their skin feels after use.
Several reviewers find the container small and the product overpriced for its size.
Some reviewers note the product leaked or had to be stirred heavily to mix the oil with the sugar.
Some reviewers describe the scrub as not overly oily, leaving less mess and no greasy feel on skin.
